description: A small Rubik’s Cube sits on the green tabletop in front of you, with white boards leaning in the background. The left hand reaches in from the left and the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the cube as a two-hand object, then both hands lift it slightly and make a series of quick twists—turning the top and side layers in alternating directions while the cube is rotated in the hands before being brought back down.
